questions.q: What did the suitcase contain when Mudduawulira picked it up?
questions.explain: The suitcase contained a snake which scared Mudduawulira.

questions.q: What did Mudduawulira do after his father asked him to pick up the suitcase?
questions.explain: Mudduawulira put the suitcase on his head and carried it home.

questions.q: Who got scared when the snake slithered out of the suitcase?
questions.explain: Both father and son were scared when the snake landed on Mudduawulira's feet.
